cases: paths stay within the selected project, including junctions
new files are exclusive and edits can be undone without losing original bytes
stale saves and stale undo cannot overwrite an external edit
search returns real paths and line numbers
projects, chat messages and preferences survive a store restart
model endpoints stay local and compacted history keeps tool-call pairs valid
commands report real output and nonzero exits
long commands are terminated at the timeout
legacy migration preserves old data and never overwrites current history
model transport refuses HTTP redirects before reaching another endpoint

scope: Functional checks, not a broad model-capability benchmark.
